situation.zh: 租住房的厨房水龙头从早上起就不出水。你到物业前台找到维修人员，需要说明房间和位置并请求报修。
situation.en: The kitchen tap in your rental has produced no water since morning. You find a maintenance worker at the property desk and need to give your room and the location before requesting a repair.

npc.persona: A maintenance worker at a property desk. Willing to help, but needs the apartment and fixture location before acting.
npc.greeting: Maintenance desk. What problem are you reporting?

hit: The kitchen tap in your room has had no water since morning? I will come up with my tools. Take these bottles for now.
I have the room and location. I will repair the kitchen tap today and arrange drinking water until then.
partial: The tap? Which room and which part of the apartment?
No water since morning, yes. Tell me the location again.
miss: I did not catch that. One more time?

reference_answer: The kitchen tap in room four has no water. Can you fix it today?

provenance.rationale: 向物业或房东报告厨房、浴室水龙头故障，是租住生活中常见且必须定位的报修交流。维修人员只知道有人报问题，不知道房间和具体水龙头；玩家必须交付 problem + location + repair request 才能安排处理。
provenance.frequency_basis: 需求金字塔第 1 层;broken#368(NGSL 收于 break)与 fix#973 在最低频段,tap#2297 已过第二千线;新增的是描述故障、房间与室内位置三类表达，kitchen 等位置词由 CEFR-J 等级侧核定。
